lecture_context.lecture_title: Lecture 4: Adversarial Robustness and Generative Models

unit.name: Diffusion denoising objective and self-supervised training set
unit.description: Defines the reverse denoising task, the reconstruction loss on predicted noise, and the construction of training triplets from forward diffusion.
unit.summary: The reverse process trains a diffusion model to predict the cumulative noise epsilon-hat that was added between x0 and a noisy image xt [ts=5064s]. If the predicted noise can be subtracted from xt, the model can recover the original clean image, so denoising becomes the core generative skill [ts=5097s]. The reconstruction loss compares the true stored noise with the model’s predicted cumulative noise, and this is self-supervised because the forward process created the labels [ts=5161s]. The training database is built from noisy images, a time-step index t, and the cumulative noise epsilon; the index tells the model how much denoising is being requested [ts=5232s]. Before inference, the instructor summarizes the training loop as sampling triplets, computing reconstruction loss, and using gradients to teach the model to predict noise given a noisy picture [ts=5435s].

key_points.text: The denoising model predicts cumulative noise epsilon-hat added from x0 to xt.
Subtracting the predicted noise from xt should recover the original clean image x0.
The reconstruction loss is the L2 distance between true noise epsilon and predicted noise epsilon-hat.
Forward diffusion creates self-supervised labels because the training process stores the exact noise it added.
Training samples are triplets containing a noisy image, time-step index, and cumulative noise.

kp_catalog.name: Forward diffusion process
kp_catalog.description: A noising process that transforms clean data into increasingly noisy states by adding Gaussian noise over time, creating the supervised signal for denoising.
kp_catalog.importance_rationale: Forward diffusion is foundational within diffusion models, but should support the broader diffusion-denoising gateway.

kp_catalog.name: Diffusion denoising intuition
kp_catalog.description: Diffusion generates by starting from noise and repeatedly removing small amounts of noise.
kp_catalog.importance_rationale: Important because diffusion denoising intuition formalizes how diffusion generates by starting from noise and repeatedly removing small amounts of noise, which later units use as core machinery rather than background context.
